_why: The reputation lists only show the quest that PAYS reputation. Where that quest ends a World Quest series, the earlier parts pay nothing and never appear, so the row understates the work and its length tier measures the final part alone.
_caveat: Counts are a LOWER BOUND. The wiki's prev field is not filled in on every page, so a quest can report fewer priors than it really has — Memory's Final Chapter reports 1 while its requirement names an entire series.
_source: Genshin Impact Wiki infobox fields `requirement` and `prev`, via api.php

_resetGatedNote: Series listed here are gated by daily reset between parts, so their length score understates them badly: a 3-part tail is 3 days minimum regardless of how short each part reads. Check this before telling anyone to 'just finish the chain'. Run reset-gated chains in parallel with ungated quests, never instead of them.

The Moon-Bathed Deep.startsWith: Talk to Tsuyuko, north of Mouun Shrine on Watatsumi Island. Requires A New Star Approaches and Ritou Escape Plan - both done, so this is startable now.
The Moon-Bathed Deep.unlocks: Enkanomiya, via The Still Water's Flow. That opens The Subterranean Trials of Drake and Serpent, and behind it Collection of Dragons and Snakes, Lotus Eater, The Phaethons' Syrtos and The Three Great Martial Trials - five more reputation quests.
The Moon-Bathed Deep.note: Seven quests for 200 reputation directly, but it is the single biggest unlock left: five further quests sit behind it. Everything else still outstanding is gated on chains like this one.
The Moon-Bathed Deep.repAmtConflict: The wiki infobox gives "Heart of Watatsumi" repAmt=20, but the in-game Not-achieved list shows it at 100. The game screen wins; flagged in case the wiki value turns out to be right.

sealSolutions.\"Eye of Watatsumi\": Elemental Sight finds 3 Elemental Orbs; disperse each with PYRO, CRYO, ANEMO or GEO. Electro and Hydro DO NOT work - Hydro visually Electro-Charges the orb, which looks like progress and is not. Enemies spawn but need not be killed. CLEARED 11 Nov 2026.
sealSolutions.\"Fang of Watatsumi\": Protect a Ley Line Monolith through 5 waves. The only one of the four that is a straight fight, so bring the damage.
sealSolutions.\"Fin of Watatsumi\": Rotate the fish statues so a blue line of the circle shows below, then interact with the Mysterious Pillar. The two discs do NOT need to be aligned at the same time, which is the part people fight against.
sealSolutions.\"Tail of Watatsumi\": Use an Electrogranum to light 6 Electric Lamps, then beat a Fatui ambush (Hydrogunner, Cryogunner, Pyroslinger).
sealSolutions._note: Eye, Fang, Fin and Tail can be done in ANY order; all four Spirit Pearls are needed before the fifth seal, the Heart, opens.

The Moon-Bathed Deep.progress: All four Spirit Pearls obtained and "Heart of Watatsumi" completed 11 Nov 2026. Fin was the one that stalled: each seal is a separate world quest picked up by reading its stone tablet on site, so it never appeared in the log until the user walked there.

stillWatersFlow.steps: Tsuyuko -> Tsuyuko at the altar -> find 2 Key Sigils -> activate 2 altars -> Tsuyuko -> descend into Enkanomiya -> investigate the cavern.
stillWatersFlow.keySigils: One at Fin of Watatsumi (Ruin Defender, Ruin Scout), one at Heart of Watatsumi (Fatui Hydrogunner, Mirror Maiden). The sigils can be picked up WITHOUT fighting - the enemies are scenery, not a gate.
stillWatersFlow.payoff: Completing it unlocks Enkanomiya's southernmost Teleport Waypoint and the achievement N-Thousand Leagues Under the Sea.

_plan.plan: Switch to storyline now; return to reputation next week and take Level 9 and the Electro Treasure Compass from weekly Bounties rather than quests.
_plan.why: 620 to Level 9. Three 5-star Bounties pay 600 + 90,000 Mora in a week; six world quests pay the same reputation for far more time.
nextWeek: Hyakubei -> Bounties. Take the highest-value one, complete it, and the list refreshes - repeat for all 3 claims.
Then 3 Requests at 80 each if the compass is still short.
_plan.storylineOverlap: Through the Mists on Tsurumi is BOTH storyline and reputation: it is reset-gated one step per day, and ends in The Sun-Wheel and Mt. Kanna (100) with The Saga of Mr. Forgetful (100) after it. Advancing it daily during storyline weeks costs nothing extra and banks 200.
loose: Treatment on the Island - if started, step 4 needs 18:00-21:00 in game.
The Entrance to Tokoyo - worth finishing for Enkanomiya's southernmost waypoint, so later trips skip the descent.
_plan.unverified: The weekly reset day/time for Bounties and Requests is not stated on the Reputation page. Trounce Domain claims reset Monday 04:00 server time and these likely match, but that is an assumption.
